releaseNotes:
• Material 3 Single-Activity 4-Fragment Architecture: Replaced legacy scrolling monolith with 4 instant zero-scroll tabs (Home, Gallery, History, Settings) powered by BottomNavigationView and 120Hz show()/hide() tab switching.
• High-Speed 120Hz Gallery: 2-column media grid with real-time category filtering (Photos, Reels, Carousels), multi-item batch selection, and smooth bidirectional shared-element transitions.
• Revamped History & Archive: Instant SQLite load with live header summary, filter chips, unified non-overlapping IO thumbnail and metadata backfill, and flattened cards with ViewStub progress.
• Application-Scoped Re-download Queue: Moved sequential queue to RedownloadQueueManager on InstaSaveApp.applicationScope with reactive StateFlow progress tracking that survives screen rotations and tab changes.
• Deep-Linked Notifications & Floating HUD: Tapping download notifications or the Dynamic Island HUD pill routes directly into the Gallery tab.
• Android 16 Scoped Storage & Predictive Back: Full edge-to-edge support with adjustNothing keyboard handling and rotation-safe deletion consent.
